_README: PINNED API CONTRACT SNAPSHOT — the source of truth for the CLASS-34 bidirectional contract gate.
Each entry is ONE auth-service endpoint. It records the TOP-LEVEL json field names the goauth
handler MEANINGFULLY decodes (request_accepts — fields it actually consumes, NOT merely-ignored
ones) and encodes (response_returns), plus the response envelope (object|array).
The gate (contract_gate_test.go) reflects the paired SDK request/response Go structs and fails
the build (it runs under `go test`) on ANY of the four CLASS-34 categories:
1 MISSING-ON-REQUEST  — API accepts a field the SDK request struct omits.
2 MISSING-ON-RESPONSE — API returns a field the SDK response struct omits.
3 OVER-EXPOSURE       — SDK sends/reads a field not in the API set (footgun) unless allow-listed.
4 ENVELOPE-MISMATCH   — array-vs-object / wrapper-vs-flat: the SDK binding kind must match.
allow_request_extra / allow_response_extra: intentional deviations, each with a WRITTEN REASON.
request_custom_marshal:true — the SDK request type has a custom MarshalJSON (reflection can't
see the wire); the request check is delegated to its dedicated wire-shape test (named in note).
REGENERATION: this is hand-derived from the cited goauth handler structs (file:line in each
note). When the server legitimately changes a shape, update the affected entry from the handler
and adjust the SDK struct + its wire-shape test in the same change. HOUSE STANDARD: the same
gate harness should be adopted by the other Go SDKs (ab0t-quota-go, hooks-go, skills-go).

PUT /organizations/{org_id}/login-config.note: goauth orgs/loginconfig.go:216-221,295-407 (partial deep-merge; unknown top-level key -> 400)

POST /zanzibar/stores/{store_id}/authori.note: goauth zanzibarhttp/authmodels.go:142-149,362-398; request has custom MarshalJSON, see TestWireShape_WriteAuthorizationModel_FlatBody

allow_response_extra.message: some deployments echo a message; harmless, ticket P0-3

allow_request_extra.expires_at: server ignores it; retained w/ disclosed godoc (P1-b/P3-d)

POST /providers/.note: goauth providerswire/handlers.go:125-134 (org_id accepted but ignored -> excluded)

POST /auth/oauth/token.note: RFC 8693 token-exchange (OBO) response, §2.2.1 — appv2 _generate_delegated_token (auth_service_base.py:3087-3099); bound to ExchangeResponse via ExchangeToken. Request is form-encoded (grant_type URN via TokenExchangeForm), not a JSON struct, so this pins the RESPONSE only. ExchangeResponse surfaces issued_token_type which TokenResponse (the raw OAuthToken path) drops.

POST /organizations/.note: goauth orgs/create.go:19-32 (billing_type NOT accepted; forced PREPAID)

PUT /organizations/{org_id}.note: goauth orgs/detail.go:35-48 (billing_type present in struct but 400-rejected; status NOT in schema)

POST /zanzibar/stores/{store_id}/write.note: goauth zanzibarhttp/transact.go:27-43; request has custom MarshalJSON, see TestWireShape_TransactWriteBody

allow_response_extra.success: shared generic MessageResponse envelope carries an optional success flag
